The complete sentence for answer choice (c) means: “I memorize English vocabulary to prepare for my English test.” Example: 「スピーチの原稿をすべて暗記して本番に臨んだ。」 (“I memorized the entire speech script before giving the actual speech.”) Distinguish 「暗記」, committing something to memory, from writing something down, as in choices (a) and (b). Also avoid confusing the kanji 暗 in 「暗記」 (“memorization”) with 「暗号」 (“code,” choice (d)).

default.q.test-15-q1-1.why.3: ✗ (d) To describe secretly transmitting information so that the other party will not notice, use「暗号」(code/cipher), not「暗記」.

Distinguish 「休暇」from the adjective 「暇」(ひま), meaning free or having spare time, and from the verbs 「休む／欠勤する」, which refer to taking time off due to illness. Also remember that 「休暇」does not directly combine with「する」to form a verb.
